# Draft:The Debate and Historical Society

----
}}
The Debate and Historical Society (Commonly known as the Debatical) is a Northern Irish based student debating Society founded in 2025. The purposes of the Society is to "encourage debating, free speech, and open debate for the student body of the college and all."
